时笙坐着布丁，横冲直撞的往缥缈宗飞，还没进宗门就被人拦了。

“什么人？缥缈宗上空不许飞行！”

几名穿着缥缈宗道袍的弟子踩着飞剑拦在时笙面前，看清上面的人，面色异常，惊讶中带着几分隐晦的打量，“商师叔……”

看到站在时笙旁边的凤辞，更是面露惊惧，纷纷往后面退了一段距离。

时笙莫名其妙的看了他们一眼。

这才多久不见，不认识了？还是她能吃人啊？

时笙进去后，才明白那些人干嘛用这种眼光看自己。

叶清秋已经回宗门了，而且还和宗主说，她联合外人动手要杀她，现在整个缥缈宗都在传她如何如何心狠手辣，残害同门。

那说得好像真有那么一回事似的。

“我帮你杀了他们。”凤辞眼底隐隐有些戾气。

他的人，除了他，谁也说不得。

时笙赶紧拉住凤辞，“说两句又不会少块肉，让他们说去。”妈个鸡动不动就杀人，这人形杀器本宝宝驾驭不来啊！

凤辞迷茫的看着时笙，余光扫到她拉着自己的手，眼底的戾气这才慢慢的退下去。

“我们先回天尽峰……”时笙的声音嘎然而止，她侧目看向旁边的建筑，远处隐约站着几个人。

“我师叔才不是那种人，楚凝，我告诉你，你别在这里胡说八道，诋毁师叔！”

“我胡说？现在全宗门上下谁不知道，你有本事去堵他们的嘴啊！你看你师叔都不敢回来了，如果不是她做了，她怎么会不敢回来？”

“胡说！”

“林一一，你想干什么？……林一一是你先动手的，那就别怪我了！”

一开始是林一一先动的手，但是楚凝那边有好几个人，林一一一个人根本没有胜算，不过几招，就落在了下风。

时笙眉头微蹙，“在这里等我，不许出来，也不许动手。”

凤辞不高兴的看着时笙，张了张嘴，可还不等他反驳，时笙继续道：“你不是说要听我的吗？”

凤辞抿着唇角，几秒后才松开时笙。

Shi Sheng sat on Pudding and flew towards the Piaomiao Sect, but was stopped before entering the sect.

"Who is it? Flying is not allowed over the Piaomiao Sect!"

Several disciples wearing Piao Miao sect robes stood in front of Shi Sheng with flying swords. When they saw the people above them clearly, their expressions were abnormal, and they looked at them with a hint of surprise, "Uncle Shang..."

Seeing Feng Ci standing next to Shi Sheng, their faces were even more frightened, and they all stepped back some distance.

Shi Sheng glanced at them inexplicably.

How long has it been since we last met? Don’t we recognize each other?Or can she eat people?

After Shi Sheng went in, he realized why those people looked at him in such a way.

Ye Qingqiu has returned to the sect, and even told the sect leader that she united with outsiders to kill her. Now the whole Piao Miao Sect is spreading rumors about how ruthless and ruthless she was, killing her fellow sect members.

That makes it sound like that's really the case.

"I'll help you kill them." There was a hint of anger in Feng Ci's eyes.

His people, no one can tell except him.

Shi Sheng quickly grabbed Feng Ci and said, "If you say a few words without missing a piece of meat, let them talk." Mom is a chicken who kills people at every turn. I can't control this humanoid murder weapon!

Feng Ci looked at Shi Sheng in confusion. From the corner of his eye, he saw her holding his hand, and the anger in her eyes slowly receded.

"Let's go back to Tianjin Peak first..." Shi Sheng's voice stopped abruptly. She looked sideways at the building next to her. There were a few people standing vaguely in the distance.

"My uncle is not that kind of person, Chu Ning, let me tell you, don't talk nonsense here and slander your uncle!"

"Am I talking nonsense? Now everyone in the whole sect doesn't know that you have the ability to stop their mouths! You see, your uncle doesn't dare to come back. If she hadn't done it, why wouldn't she dare to come back?"

"Nonsense!"

"Lin Yiyi, what do you want to do?...Lin Yiyi, you did it first, so don't blame me!"

At first, Lin Yiyi made the first move, but there were several people on Chu Ning's side. Lin Yiyi had no chance of winning by himself. After just a few moves, he was at a disadvantage.

Shi Sheng frowned slightly, "Wait for me here. You are not allowed to come out, and you are not allowed to make any move."

Feng Ci looked at Shi Sheng unhappily and opened his mouth, but before he could refute, Shi Sheng continued: "Didn't you say you want to listen to me?"

Feng Ci pursed her lips, and then let go of Shi Sheng after a few seconds.
